description: Repeat the complete seven-test evaluation after merging dispatch fusion into main. Hypothesis: the merged main preserves the performance and correctness observed before merge; source code is unchanged relative to the prior evaluated implementation, with only documentation changes. Keep dispatch mask 29, affine-8 group-64 v2 target, BF16 draft, FP16 KV and operands, FP32 state and accumulation, 2048-token chunks, 32768-token context, prefix caching and all serving flags unchanged. Pin the latest repository main for evaluation; evaluator definition and code are byte-identical to the base. This is a post-merge replication, not a new optimization.
